note: Sample enrichment — one full theme (CR-01) to eyeball the drawer/manifest/Lark wiring before the 600-unit run. Authored fields only; derived art-direction stays runtime-computed.

CR-01.A1.scrollStopper: Top-down macro of an open metal cash tin crammed with crumpled order chits, one RM50 note caught mid-fall; blurred dinner-queue bokeh behind.
CR-01.A1.openLoop: Tin looks full — so why don't the takings match?

valuePropReveal.what: POS + Reporting & Analytics logs every sale the second it happens

CR-01.A1.heroProp: open metal cash tin overflowing with paper chits

onFrameText.text: Half these orders never hit the till.

lever.hypothesis: visualized loss (the overflowing tin) beats merely stated loss for thumbstop

CR-01.A2.scrollStopper: Hard 1:1 split — left half a fist of paper chits stamped RM3,200, right half a near-empty cash tin stamped RM2,650, the RM550 gap glowing orange down the seam.
CR-01.A2.openLoop: Same day, two totals — where did RM550 go?

valuePropReveal.what: POS rings every order so chits and takings reconcile to the cent

CR-01.A2.heroProp: stack of paper chits vs cash tin

lever.hypothesis: an explicit before/after gap converts better than implied loss

CR-01.A3.scrollStopper: Selfie-framed kitchen staffer leaning into the lens mid-shift, voice lowered, glancing off-camera toward the boss — confessional energy.
CR-01.A3.openLoop: Why is the staff the one telling you this?

valuePropReveal.what: QR Order & Pay + POS capture every order automatically — nothing rides on memory

onFrameText.text: Boss — half these orders never went into the system.

lever.hypothesis: a staff confession (others-perspective) out-stops owner-POV for a cold owner

CR-01.A4.scrollStopper: Live tally counter on a dark frame races to 240 PLATES SERVED, a second counter stalls at 180 RECORDED, the 60-plate gap flashing orange between them.
CR-01.A4.openLoop: You served 240 — the system saw 180. Where did 60 go?

valuePropReveal.what: Reporting & Analytics records every sale, so served = recorded

lever.hypothesis: sharpened number-gap hook beats the generic 'profit you can't keep' line

CR-01.A5.scrollStopper: Slow cinematic push on a tired kopitiam owner at close, lit by a single warm pendant, staring into an almost-empty cash tin after a packed day.
CR-01.A5.openLoop: Busiest day of the week — so why is the tin nearly empty?

valuePropReveal.what: POS + Reporting & Analytics shows exactly where the day's money went

CR-01.A5.heroProp: nearly-empty cash tin under warm pendant light
CR-01.A5.sceneDetail: after-close kopitiam, chairs up on two tables, warm tungsten key from one pendant, steam off a last kopi; SEA owner 40s, apron still on.
CR-01.A5.lightingNote: single warm pendant key, deep falloff, no fill — money-anxiety mood, never clinical.

lever.hypothesis: cinematic restraint can out-perform high-energy data for a calm-pain mindset

CR-01.VID.motionFirst: a fat stack of paper chits SLAPS onto the counter, hand still in frame — hard impact on frame 1, no slow build.
CR-01.VID.soundHook: the slap of paper on steel + a single coin spin; no music until the turn beat.
CR-01.VID.scrollStopper: Chit stack slams the counter beside an empty cash tin; RM3,200 then RM2,650 stamp on screen.

valuePropReveal.what: POS + Reporting & Analytics — every sale rings itself, takings match to the cent

CR-01.VID.sceneDetail: kopitiam back-counter at close; real chits, real steel cash tin; numbers stamp in Barlow over the live footage.

lever.hypothesis: an artifact-native receipt-tally hijack stops scroll better than a talking-head explainer
